source_caption:
Succession follows the Roy family, owners of one of the world's largest media and entertainment companies. As aging patriarch Logan Roy's health declines, his children begin a ruthless battle to succeed him, turning family relationships into a high-stakes struggle for power, wealth, and control of the company.

In Succession, the story blends corporate drama, dark comedy, and family conflict while exploring themes of ambition, greed, loyalty, betrayal, and the corrosive effects of power. Starring Brian Cox, Jeremy Strong, and Sarah Snook, the series is widely regarded as one of the finest television dramas of the 21st century for its sharp writing, complex characters, and outstanding performances.
